interactionIdea.title: Free recorder comparison and audition bench
interactionIdea.supportedFacts: Manufacturer supports H1n simple stereo recording and H4n Pro stereo/4CH/MTR modes with external inputs. Merchant offers recording-gear advice.
interactionIdea.proposal: Place two clearly labeled demo models on a comparison bench; inspect mic configuration, input ports, dimensions and controls; select stereo interview vs multi-input rehearsal use cases, then watch an original hand/record-button animation and a synthetic level meter.
interactionIdea.limits: Free interaction; no microphone permission, real customer recordings, shopping charge or reproduced merchant sound demo required. Synthetic meter/audio must be identified as game demonstration, not a measured sonic comparison or real sound-quality emulation.
